objective.text: Meet Tam in the village and take his tools.

observation: RIG, 2026-08-31 (lane ralph/GATE-F-LEG-S03, which needs a real S02-exit to enter S03 from). This block used to open the shell with `game_menu` (Start) and cycle five tabs right. Start is ALSO `backpack_drop` (project.godot; the two share gamepad button 6), so the press that opens the shell onto the Satchel can also fire the destructive drop verb and raise a 'Drop it? / Cancel' confirmation -- and S02-63b existed to dismiss it with B. The trouble is that the confirmation is TIMING-DEPENDENT: tab_backpack.gd's `_ignore_drop_until_release` guard sometimes holds and sometimes does not. When it holds there is no confirmation to dismiss, and the unconditional B press closes the SHELL instead. That is what happened on this lane's run: S02-63 reported focus on '' rather than 'Drop it', B closed the shell, the five RB presses went to the world, S02-65 correctly read input_context=world, and no handoff save was written -- so the chain could not continue past S02. A step that must guess whether a modal is present is CD-3's own failure shape ('reach a state, then assert it'), and the vocabulary has no conditional press. So the fix is to stop needing the guess: `open_menu` with a `tab` presses THAT TAB'S OWN SHORTCUT (data/config/menu.json `shortcuts`) rather than Start, so the drop verb is never fired and no confirmation can appear. There is no `save` shortcut, only `inventory`->backpack and `map`->map, so this opens on Map and walks three tabs right (map -> quest_log -> build -> save). This is not a new pattern: it is exactly what S03-265/266 already does for the same handoff save, and S03's save block has never had this failure.
